architecture: aarch64 Linux, native ARM64 Docker execution; Rust 1.90 release
limits: Synthetic SDK and synthetic ROS C ABI bridge; no physical camera, USB or actual DDS. CPU sums worker/supervisor time; RSS sums separate process high-water marks. No concurrent builds/tests during performance timing.

allocation_probe.scope: isolated process, all Rust allocations after platform/SDK warmup; excludes C SDK malloc

alternating.limits: synthetic C SDK and bridge; includes producer callback thread overhead, excludes USB and actual DDS costs; CPU sums capture worker and supervisor; RSS sums process high-water marks, not simultaneous or anonymous RSS; native recording uses serial chunked-v3; target/window in report metadata
